verdict.rationale: Puzzle is accounting software, so inviting an external accountant with role-scoped permissions is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents user invitations, roles, or permission scoping. The accountant-facing marketing (QuickBooks migration, client data) and the multi-entity-under-one-login feature are related but different capabilities, and neither shows a founder granting scoped access to the books.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
